title: CLAUDE.md
text: ggpyramid R package extends ggplot2 building population pyramids (back--back bar charts population age group sex). Matan Hakim’s personal open-source package, public GitHub matanhakim/ggpyramid, pkgdown site https://matanhakim.github.io/ggpyramid/. Sibling packages author live next (../il.cbs.muni, ../rtlr) set house conventions DESCRIPTION, pkgdown CI; match . Status (Oct 2026): built geom_pyramid(), stat_pyramid(), position_pyramid() coord_pyramid(). Next per plan: text outline layers (geom_pyramid_text(), geom_pyramid_outline()), scale_x_pyramid() theme_pyramid(). Design research, architecture alternatives agreed API live dev/design-research.md (Hebrew); section 8 records Matan’s decisions, nothing implemented ahead . Throwaway prototypes dev/spikes/; dev/ build-ignored. Architecture: PositionPyramid (inherits PositionStack) owns correctness. negates value axis left side, stacks within side, geom can take position = "pyramid". side comes side aesthetic (declared Position’s default_aes), else fill, else colour. StatPyramid counts rows sums mapped value writes counts , denominator, proportions straight value axis; constructors attach child stat whose default_aes names axis. Orientation defaults horizontal (age y) axes continuous. CoordPyramid (inherits CoordCartesian, horizontal ) owns look: wraps x view scale absolute labels, makes limits symmetric, moves age scale modify_scales(), opens centre gap transform(), axis keys grid lines also pass . zero belongs side row; lone zero left negative zero written Position. Build negative zeros -abs(x): byte compiler folds literal -0 0.

title: Population Pyramids with ggplot2
text: geom_pyramid() draws bars. sums value one mapped, , counts rows , accepts aggregated data individual records. example data synthetic.  coord_pyramid() takes care axes. labels sides without minus sign gives range, can move age axis right, sides, gap centre pyramid:  denominator turns bars proportions, whole panel side, facet gets denominator.  position_pyramid() mirroring, layer can join pyramid position = "pyramid":  side bar comes fill unless side mapped. Mapping separately stacks subgroups within side:
code: library(ggplot2) library(ggpyramid)  ages <- c(paste0(seq(0, 80, 5), "-", seq(4, 84, 5)), "85+") set.seed(1) pop <- expand.grid(   age = factor(ages, ages),   sex = factor(c("Male", "Female"), c("Male", "Female")),   region = c("North", "South") ) pop$n <- round(1000 * exp(-as.integer(pop$age) / 9) * runif(nrow(pop), 0.9, 1.1))  ggplot(subset(pop, region == "North"), aes(x = n, y = age, fill = sex)) +   geom_pyramid(width = 1, colour = "white") +   coord_pyramid() +   labs(x = "Population", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +   theme_minimal() ggplot(subset(pop, region == "North"), aes(x = n, y = age, fill = sex)) +   geom_pyramid(width = 1, colour = "white") +   coord_pyramid(age_axis = "centre") +   labs(x = "Population", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +   theme_minimal() +   theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()) ggplot(pop, aes(x = n, y = age, fill = sex)) +   geom_pyramid(denominator = "side", width = 1) +   scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +   coord_pyramid() +   facet_wrap(vars(region)) +   labs(x = "Share of each sex", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +   theme_minimal() ggplot(subset(pop, region == "North"), aes(x = n, y = age, fill = sex)) +   geom_pyramid(width = 1) +   geom_text(aes(label = n, hjust = -0.15), position = "pyramid", size = 2.5) +   scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.1)) +   coord_pyramid() +   labs(x = "Population", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +   theme_minimal() ggplot(pop, aes(x = n, y = age, fill = region, side = sex)) +   geom_pyramid(width = 1) +   coord_pyramid() +   labs(x = "Population", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +   theme_minimal()

See fortify() variables created. function called single argument, plot data. return value must data.frame, used layer data. function can created formula (e.g. ~ head(.x, 10)). stat statistical transformation use data layer. default, "pyramid", stat_pyramid(). position position adjustment. default, "pyramid", position_pyramid(); call set arguments, example position = position_pyramid(left = "Female"). ... arguments passed ggplot2::layer(), bar width fixed aesthetics like colour = "white". denominator NULL (default) shows counts. code: library(ggplot2)  pop <- data.frame(   age = factor(rep(c("0-19", "20-39", "40-59", "60+"), 2)),   sex = factor(rep(c("Male", "Female"), each = 4), c("Male", "Female")),   n = c(220, 200, 160, 90, 210, 205, 170, 120) )  # Any geom can be mirrored ggplot(pop, aes(x = n, y = age, fill = sex)) +   geom_col(position = position_pyramid()) +   geom_text(aes(label = n, hjust = -0.2), position = "pyramid") +   scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.15)) +   coord_pyramid()   # Subgroups stack within each side pop2 <- rbind(transform(pop, group = "A"), transform(pop, group = "B")) ggplot(pop2, aes(x = n, y = age, fill = group, side = sex)) +   geom_col(position = position_pyramid(left = "Female"))
